title: Kagamine Rin — Merry-Go-Round Merriment!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Which SEKAI should I take a look at today?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I could do that thing I did with Len the other day again. I'll walk in a straight line, and whichever SEKAI I run into, that's where I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's see... Which way should I go?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Was that a band playing just now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll make a quick detour before I test my luck.
School SEKAI
Station

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Found 'em!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ichika and the girls are also with them.
But why are they practicing here instead of in one of the classrooms?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Phew... That was pretty good!
I think it was our best performance yet today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was really feeling it♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too♪
And playing that one part together was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I really got into it, too. Did you notice anything to work on, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I also agree that it was the best we've done today.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki
rows.Line: Cool!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's rare of you to praise them like this, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, I say that they did well when they do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean it's gonna happen again?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Again...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We already watered it and we just put on an amazing performance, so the tree might start glowing again...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The tree...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Everyone was sent to different SEKAI while watering their trees.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do they think that doing the same thing will cause that to happen again?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Unfortunately...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Nothing seems to be happening...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aw, but why not?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just performing the same set of actions doesn't seem to be enough.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, getting sent off to another SEKAI is a pretty big deal, so it's for the best it doesn't happen that easily.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, but I really wanna go to the SEKAI that Rin got to visit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah, so they are trying to visit the same SEKAI again.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But that really was just a happy accident, or maybe a miracle...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And we still don't really know the real cause as to why that happened.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haven't you had enough, Rin? Let's head back to the classroom...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, let's try one more time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Something might happen next time!
So, let's play again!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ichika and the girls need this time to prepare for their show, Rin. We can't keep them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, don't worry about us.
This is actually good practice for us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's not how you normally practice, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And Rin, you get it, don't you?
It just isn't that easy to travel to another SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Just one more time! I'm going back to that SEKAI no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Normally, “I” wouldn't cause everyone else so much trouble like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So why is she...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's okay, KAITO. You don't have to worry about us. I'm pretty sure we all understand how Rin feels.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're doing this for us, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We heard all about the fun you and KAITO got to have when you two were sent over to that SEKAI, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you want us to be able to have fun like that over there too, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... It was so much fun over there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But we couldn't go together...
It isn't fair that only the two of us got to have so much fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It isn't fair...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I guess she's right. It would be better to share that fun with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Now I see...
That's why she's acting this way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I understand your reasoning now.
But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry for making you all put up with me like this, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, your thoughtfulness means a lot to us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As far as we know, you got to go to another SEKAI because you've been doing good things each day. Or maybe you just got lucky?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Is it because I've been taking good care of the tree?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's gotta be it!
It was the tree's way of thanking you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. I sure hope that's true♪
And you should all follow my example!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank goodness she's smiling again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is how the “me” from this SEKAI should be acting!
